title: Karelia Caps Fuel Sales as Shortages Reach At Least Seven Regions After Refinery Strikes
detail: Karelia announced highway stations may sell no more than 30 L of gasoline and 50 L of diesel per customer and halted jerry-can sales; Rosneft stations in Ulan-Ude imposed similar limits. Reports (citing Reuters and Forbes.ua, via Charter97) count at least seven regions with shortages or limits, after Ukrainian strikes on eight major refineries in two weeks, including Kirishi, following the collapse of the energy truce on Oct 30. Single secondary-outlet report; Reuters original not retrieved.

media.caption: Fuel shortages spread across Russian regions
